# Jester's Stash

> Private, invite-only inventory and sales management portal for approved team members.

Jester's Stash is not a public product. Access is granted by an admin; unapproved visitors cannot reach inventory, sales, or dashboard surfaces.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the private portal and entry point to sign in.
- [Sign in](/auth): Team members sign in with credentials issued by an admin.
